MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of January 15, 2025 ("Effective Date") by and between Acme Corporation, a Delaware corporation ("Acme"), and Beta Industries LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Beta") (each a "Party" and collectively the "Parties").

1. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Each Party agrees to hold in confidence all Confidential Information disclosed by the other Party. "Confidential Information" means any non-public technical, business, or financial information disclosed by either Party.

2. TERM. This Agreement shall remain in effect for three (3) years from the Effective Date.

3. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.

4. TERMINATION. Either Party may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party.

5. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties concerning the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior agreements and understandings.
notes: Straightforward mutual NDA. No significant risks expected.

NON-DISCLOSURE AND NON-SOLICITATION AGREEMENT

This Non-Disclosure and Non-Solicitation Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of March 1, 2025 by and between Gamma Technologies Inc. ("Company") and Delta Consulting Group ("Contractor").

1. DEFINITION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information includes but is not limited to: trade secrets, proprietary technology, customer lists, business strategies, financial information, and any information marked as "Confidential."

2. OBLIGATIONS OF CONTRACTOR. Contractor agrees to: (a) maintain the Confidential Information in strict confidence; (b) use the Confidential Information solely for the purpose of performing services under the engagement; (c) not disclose the Confidential Information to any third party without prior written consent.

3. NON-SOLICITATION. During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months thereafter, Contractor shall not directly or indirectly solicit or attempt to solicit any employee or consultant of the Company to join the Contractor's business.

4. TERM. This Agreement shall be effective for twenty-four (24) months from the date first written above.

5. REMEDIES. The Contractor acknowledges that any breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm to the Company, entitling the Company to injunctive relief in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity.
notes: NDA with non-solicitation clause. 12-month non-solicitation period is aggressive but not unusual.

MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement ("Agreement") is made effective as of April 1, 2025 ("Effective Date") between Omega Software Solutions Ltd. ("Provider") and Sigma Enterprises plc ("Client").

1. SERVICES. Provider agrees to provide software development and consulting services as described in one or more Statements of Work ("SOW") to be mutually agreed upon by the Parties.

2. PAYMENT TERMS. Client shall pay Provider within thirty (30) days of receipt of a valid invoice. Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of 1.5% per month.

3. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. All intellectual property developed by Provider specifically for Client under a SOW shall be owned by Client upon full payment. Pre-existing Provider intellectual property shall remain owned by Provider.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each Party shall maintain the confidentiality of the other Party's Confidential Information and shall not disclose such information to any third party without written consent.

5. TERM AND TERMINATION. This Agreement shall continue for an initial term of twelve (12) months and shall automatically renew for successive twelve-month periods unless terminated by either Party with sixty (60) days written notice.

6. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.
notes: Standard MSA for software services. Auto-renewal and interest rate are watch-out items.

EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of June 1, 2025 between Theta Healthcare Systems ("Employer") and Dr. Maria Santos ("Employee").

1. POSITION AND DUTIES. Employee shall serve as Senior Physician at the Employer's medical facility, performing such duties as are customary for such position.

2. COMPENSATION. Employee shall receive an annual base salary of $250,000, payable in accordance with Employer's standard payroll practices. Employee shall also be eligible for an annual performance bonus of up to 20% of base salary.

3. BENEFITS. Employee shall be entitled to participate in all employee benefit plans offered by Employer, including health insurance, retirement savings plan, and twenty-five (25) days of paid time off per year.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY. Employee agrees to maintain the confidentiality of all patient information and proprietary business information of Employer.

5. TERMINATION. Either Party may terminate this Agreement at any time with or without cause upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party.
notes: Standard employment agreement with at-will termination. No non-compete present.

SOFTWARE AS A SERVICE AGREEMENT

This Software as a Service Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of February 1, 2025 between CloudScale Platform Inc. ("Provider") and Retail Dynamics Corporation ("Customer").

1. SERVICES. Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to access and use the CloudScale platform ("Service") during the Subscription Term.

2. SUBSCRIPTION FEES. Customer shall pay a monthly subscription fee of $5,000. Fees are due on the first day of each month. Provider reserves the right to suspend access if payment is not received within ten (10) days of the due date.

3. DATA SECURITY. Provider shall implement and maintain appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect Customer data against unauthorized access or disclosure.

4. SERVICE LEVELS. Provider guarantees 99.5% uptime availability, measured monthly. For each full percentage point below the guarantee, Customer shall receive a service credit equal to 5% of the monthly fee.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. IN NO EVENT SHALL PROVIDER'S TOTAL LIABILITY EXCEED THE FEES PAID BY CUSTOMER IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. Provider retains all rights, title, and interest in and to the Service, including all software, algorithms, and documentation.

7. TERM. This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for an initial term of twelve (12) months. Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve-month periods unless either Party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term.
notes: SaaS agreement with standard liability cap and auto-renewal. Watch for the suspension clause and low liability cap relative to contract value.

CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-COMPETE AGREEMENT

This Confidentiality and Non-Compete Agreement ("Agreement") is made as of May 1, 2025 between Zeta Manufacturing Co. ("Employer") and James Chen ("Employee").

RECITALS:
WHEREAS, Employer desires to protect its legitimate business interests, including confidential information, trade secrets, and goodwill; and
WHEREAS, Employee acknowledges that during employment, Employee will have access to confidential and proprietary information.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the employment or continued employment of Employee and the compensation provided therefor, the parties agree as follows:

1. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. Employee shall hold in strict confidence all Confidential Information, as defined herein, and shall not use or disclose any Confidential Information without Employer's prior written consent.

2. NON-COMPETITION. During the term of employment and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following termination for any reason, Employee shall not directly or indirectly engage in, have any ownership interest in, or participate in the financing, operation, management, or control of any person, firm, corporation, or entity that competes with Employer within the Territory.

3. TERRITORY. For purposes of this Agreement, "Territory" shall mean any state or country where Employer conducts business or has actual plans to conduct business.

4. NON-SOLICITATION. During employment and for thirty-six (36) months thereafter, Employee shall not solicit any employee, consultant, or independent contractor of Employer to terminate their relationship with Employer.

5. CONSIDERATION. Employee acknowledges that the payments and benefits provided under this Agreement constitute adequate consideration for the obligations set forth herein.

6. ENFORCEABILITY. If any court determines that any provision of this Agreement is unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.

7. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California. Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be resolved exclusively in the state or federal courts located in San Francisco County, California.
notes: Challenging NDA with aggressive non-compete (24 months) and non-solicitation (36 months). Territory definition is extremely broad. Should trigger HIGH risk flags.
